senses.gloss: (I)--a son of श्राद्धदेव and श्रद्धा and father of a son Sumati by name. भा. IX. 1. १२; 2. १७.

(II)--a son of इक्ष्वाकु; liberal in his gift of cows, silver, etc. Once a cow of a certain Brahmana got mixed up with his herd, and ignorant of this he made a gift of it to another Brahmana. The owner charged him, and when both went to the king, the owner was not prepared to take anything in its place and he who got the gift would not part with it for anything; when he went to Yama's abode he sent him as a lizard for this unrighteous act; in that form he lived in a well until कृष्ण lifted it up when it became transformed into a celestial, and blessed by कृष्ण rode in an aerial car to heaven;
1: भा. X. ६४. १०-30, ४३ and ४४ [1].
release of, by कृष्ण at द्वारका;
2: Ib. X. ३७. १७.
his lust after more territory.
3: Ib. XII. 3. १०.
[page२-261+ २६]
(III)--a son of Vaivasvata Manu. Br. II. ३८. ३०; III. ६०. 2; Vi. III. 1. ३३; IV. 1. 7.
(IV)--a son of उशीनर and नृगा (भृशा, म्। प्।); his capital, Yaudheya; became lord of the Kekayas. Br. III. ७४. १९, २१; M. ४८. १८, २०, २०; Vi. IV. १८. 9.
--one of the wives of उशीनर and mother of नृग. Br. III. ७४. १८-9.
